knownExclusions: This source entry is broad DSPS lookup metadata and does not yet isolate every construction-relevant credential type.
Dwelling contractor coverage is limited to one- and two-family dwelling permit requirements and does not establish a statewide commercial general-contractor license.
Pool, spa, solar, roofing, and sheet-metal coverage is limited to applicable DSPS electrical, plumbing, HVAC, or dwelling-contractor credential scopes where those scopes apply.
Local permits, municipal registrations, and non-DSPS authorizations are outside this source entry.

researchEvidence.note: Official public source, access shape, and current automation constraints reviewed.
Official DSPS public lookup page reviewed; it directs users to LicensE License Lookup for Health, Business, Trades, Manufactured Homes, and Unarmed Combat Sports credentials and permits.
Official DSPS dwelling contractor page reviewed; it states a one- and two-family dwelling permit requires a Dwelling Contractor or restricted certification and a Dwelling Contractor Qualifier.

Official DSPS electrical contractor page reviewed; it states no person or entity may engage in or offer electrical wiring work unless licensed or certified by the Department, subject to statutory exceptions.
Official DSPS HVAC contractor page reviewed for statewide HVAC credential evidence.
Official DSPS master plumber page reviewed for statewide plumbing credential evidence.
Official DSPS utility contractor page reviewed for statewide underground utility and plumbing-related credential evidence.
